# Manifest reference

Every field of `quadflow-plugin.json`, generated from the JSON Schema the host validates against
(`packages/plugin-api/schema/quadflow-plugin.schema.json`). For what the fields *do*, see
[getting-started.md](getting-started.md) and [plugin-system.md §3](../architecture/plugin-system.md#3-manifest--quadflow-pluginjson).
Point your editor at the schema with `"$schema": "./node_modules/@quadflow/plugin-api/schema/quadflow-plugin.schema.json"`
and run `quadflow-plugin validate` (or `quadflow plugins validate <dir>`) to check a manifest.

## Value types

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| path (`relPath`) | string matching `^(?!/)(?!.*\.\.)(?!.*\\)[A-Za-z0-9._/-]+$` |
| id (`contribId`) | string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,47}$` |
| category (`category`) | `project-management`, `development`, `ai-agents`, `media`, `system`, `integrations`, `other` |
| permission (`permission`) | string matching `^(data:(ideas\\|issues\\|plans\\|discovery\\|scripts\\|ship\\|chat\\|missions):(read\\|write)\\|project:config:write\\|terminal:(spawn\\|io)\\|agents:(launch\\|read)\\|fs:(read\\|write):(project\\|home\\|any)\\|shell:exec:[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\\|shell:open-external\\|network:(\*\\|[a-z0-9.-]+(:[0-9]+)?)\\|notifications\\|clipboard:(read\\|write)\\|secrets\\|native:(windows\\|webview\\|screen-capture)\\|sidecar:runtime:node)$` |
| `when` expression (`when`) | string — Context expression (§5.5), e.g. "project && !terminal.agent" |
| JSON Schema (`jsonSchemaObject`) | object — JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) with type=object; rendered by @quadflow/ui FormFromSchema. |

Permissions are explained in [permissions.md](permissions.md).

<a id="agent-provider"></a>
## Agent provider (`contributes.agentProvider`)

Schema `packages/plugin-api/schema/agent-provider.schema.json`; see [agent-providers.md](agent-providers.md).
Launch templates may use `{model}`, `{sessionId}`, `{effort}`, `{cwd}`; path templates `{home}`, `{appData}`,
`{localAppData}`, `{cwd|nonalnum-dash}`.

| Name | Meaning |
|---|---|
| safe arg (`safeArg`) | string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9._:\[\]@=/+,-]{1,256}$` |
| arg template[] (`argTemplate`) | array of string |
| path template[] (`pathList`) | array of string — Templates with {home} {appData} {localAppData} |

### `launch`

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `args` | safe arg[] | yes | Base argv after the program |
| `model` | arg template[] |  | e.g. ["--model","{model}"]. Omitted for the system-default model |
